title: An order-preserving spectral-radius bound for fixed-length matrix products over local fields
author: Eduardo Oregón-Reyes
work: A new inequality about matrix products and a Berger-Wang formula
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 7 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.114
difficulty_reason: Exterior powers force rank reduction for blocks whose every contiguous subproduct is nilpotent. An effective multihomogeneous Nullstellensatz identity converts this zero-locus rigidity into a quantitative spectral-radius inequality respecting product order over arbitrary local fields.
